searchText: MSRP $263,509. 2026 Fleetwood Fortis 34MB Features Blackout Package Ford Driver Assist Technology Package Stackable Washer/Dryer Dual Glazed Windows Steering Stabilizer System Power Driver Seat More About This RV This RV is approximately 35 feet 6 inches in length and is built on the Power Platform chassis for a strong foundation, smooth ride, and incredible exterior storage. The 2026 Fortis abounds in new standard features which include water accumulation system, redesigned exterior entertainment center, reinforced exterior storage and much more.
